label: a lock timeout fails the gate again, so the wait is billed to the branch as a rework sendback
old:
GATE_LOCK_REASON="gate lock timeout on ${sha:0:8}: another verifier holds it; cycle skipped, no sendback"
  return 0
new:
GATE_LOCK_REASON="gate failed: gate lock timeout"
  return 1

label: the needs-ceo line is written on every timeout instead of once per head
the prettier re-gate turns a lock timeout back into a gate failure (GRC=1), reaching the sendback
old:
else
          gate_lock_decision timeout "$SLUG" "$SHA" "$STATE"
          say "#$N $SLUG: $GATE_LOCK_REASON (re-gate after auto-format); skipping this cycle"
          exit 0
        fi
